The atlas search index is owned by the **harbour crew**, and their tech lead is **Priya Raman** — that's who you'd want to talk to about the stale index.

A couple of relevant details from what I found: atlas runs a nightly refresh job at 02:00 UTC (which apparently didn't complete or succeed last night), and the index is rebuilt from Postgres, so worst case it can just be discarded and regenerated if a quick fix isn't obvious.
